import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

By default Facet names every document with a ULID: a long, sortable, opaque
id such as `06H1GPGJB49DCCDM4NV957AW3B`. Many records read better with a
number people can say out loud — Brightwater items carry `EQ-2026-0001` and
maintenance tickets carry `MT-2026-0001`. An `identifier` block on the
doctype generates such numbers. Uniqueness rules on fields keep the data
clean in a second way: no two documents may carry the same value.

## When to use this

Add an identifier when users quote document numbers in speech, email, or
print. Add `unique` when a duplicate value would be a data error, such as two
items with the same serial number.

## Before you start

- **The identifier becomes the document id.** It is generated at create time
  and never changes.
- **One counter per doctype.** Facet keeps one counter per domain and
  doctype, shared by every writer. Concurrent creates queue on a lock, so two
  writers can never draw the same number.

## Steps

<Tabs syncKey="build-mode">
<TabItem label="Builder">

1. Open the doctype in the **Builder** and find the **Identifier** section.
2. Enter the template, for example `EQ-{year}-####`.
3. Tick **Generated only** when callers must never pick their own id.
4. For uniqueness, open the field and tick **Unique**.

</TabItem>
<TabItem label="Files">

The Brightwater item doctype declares the identifier and a unique serial
number:

```yaml
# equipment/doctypes/equipment.Item.yml (extract)
identifier:
  template: "EQ-{year}-####"
fields:
  serial_number:
    type: string
    title: Serial number
    unique: true
    filters: [equality]
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

### Shape the number with a template

| Token | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `#` | One digit of the counter, zero-padded. Four digits count from `0001`. |
| `{year}` | The current year, for example `2026`. |
| `{month}` | The current month, for example `11`. |
| `{day}` | The current day, for example `26`. |
| other text | Literal text, copied as is: `EQ-`, `-`, `MT-`. |

The template needs at least one `#` group, and a group is at most 18 digits.
The counter starts at `1`. When the year or month in the template changes,
the counter resets and numbering starts again at `1`.

### Declare the identifier block

```json
"identifier": {
  "template": "EQ-{year}-####",
  "genonly": true
}
```

`genonly: true` stops callers from supplying their own id on create. Without
it, the template still generates the id when the caller omits one.

### Add unique fields

Set `unique: true` on any field whose value must differ between documents.
Facet checks the rule on every create and update. A document without the
field, or with `null`, never collides; two documents that both carry an empty
string do.

```json
"serial_number": {
  "type": "string",
  "required": true,
  "unique": true,
  "filters": ["equality"]
}
```

On an update, a document never collides with itself: its own stored value is
excluded from the check.

## Example

The Brightwater item identifier generated these ids on the running example
instance — the first forty items hold `EQ-2026-0001` through `EQ-2026-0040`:

```json
{
  "identifier": { "template": "EQ-{year}-####", "genonly": false },
  "fields": {
    "serial_number": { "type": "string", "unique": true, "filters": ["equality"] }
  }
}
```

The number is the document id, so pages show it and the API can look a
document up by it — `GET /Api/equipment/Item/EQ-2026-0001`. On 1 January,
numbering restarts at `EQ-2027-0001`.

:::caution
When every digit group reaches its maximum, Facet falls back to a ULID for
the next id. Give a fast-moving doctype enough digits, for example `######`.
:::

## Troubleshooting

### A write answers `422` with a uniqueness error

Another document of the same doctype already holds this value. Find it by
filtering the list on the field, then change the value or correct the
duplicate.

### The caller cannot choose the id

The doctype declares `genonly: true`. Callers omit the id and let Facet
generate it.

### A document carries a ULID instead of a number

The counter overflowed, or the document was created before the identifier
block was added. Identifiers apply to documents created after the block
exists.

### Two doctypes restart their counters at different times

Each template carries its own time variables. A template with `{month}`
resets monthly; a template with only `{year}` resets yearly.
